title: Viva Insights: Agent 365 Dashboard adds reporting for third-party platform agents
notes: claim 92: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: the table says no admin UI control is documented for non-public agent reporting, but Microsoft documents this as a Viva Feature Access Management control and documents managing those controls in the admin center. The statement that most employees do not use the dashboard is also unsubstantiated. The roadmap facts, licensing requirements and printed commands otherwise match the sources checked.
